conditions.method: LITERAL app pipeline — CameraClient.tsx running on localhost dev server, temporary in-loop capture hook (since removed)
conditions.pose: single subject standing still, arms relaxed at sides
conditions.note: Captured the app's raw per-frame landmarks PLUS the app's raw and smoothed camera tilt, so every metric is computed both ways. Symmetry/neck/trunk shown with raw tilt (what the app uses for compensation metrics) and smoothed tilt (what tiltFilterRef computes).
conditions.caveats: n=1, single ~2.5-min session. Longer hold => more real postural sway than the 32s standalone run. Different camera + framing than the standalone, so numbers differ; noise is condition-dependent.

headline: Real-app at-rest noise this session: shoulder symmetry ~1.8 deg SD (robust p2p ~9 deg); neck/ear noisiest at ~2.3 deg SD (robust p2p ~11 deg); trunk lean ~1.3 deg SD (p2p ~11 deg). Higher than the 32s standalone (~1 deg symmetry) — condition/duration/camera dependent. Trunk-lean p2p ~11 deg fully explains the live STRAIGHTEN flicker crossing the ~3 deg threshold. Smoothing the tilt helps modestly (trunk -15%, symmetry -7%); the app currently uses RAW tilt for compensation metrics.
